comment: Independent botl.c eval_notify_windowport_field() recipe. Seed, clock, name, Valkyrie role, rules and inputs were selected for this run. newgame()'s welcome bot() sees AC rise from 0 to the find_ac() value and picks the armor-class up rule; moveloop_preamble() then sets svc.context.rndencode, so the first moveloop bot() forces gu.update_all at BL_GOLD and AC, time and the later fields are drawn without their temporary highlights. The strength rule precedes BL_GOLD and is not affected.
